update_calendar.title: Update Calendar
update_calendar.description: Scrape the reservations and update the ical file. If true, booking fields are ignored. Placeholder weekdays and time still apply.

reservation_date.title: Reservation Date
reservation_date.description: The date to book a slot on, format: yyyy-mm-dd. Defaults to one week from now

reservation_default.title: Reservation Default
reservation_default.description: The default date to book a slot on if no explicit date is given

reservation_skip.title: Reservation Skip
reservation_skip.description: The dates to skip when trying to book a slot, format: yyyy-mm-dd

opponent.title: Opponent
opponent.description: The opponent to book a slot with

times.title: Times
times.description: The times to try to book a slot on the leden banen

leden_only.title: Leden Only
leden_only.description: Only try to book a slot on the leden banen

non_leden_times.title: Non Leden Times
non_leden_times.description: The times to try to book a slot on the non-leden banen

wait_until.title: Wait Until
wait_until.description: Europe/Amsterdam time (HH:MM or HH:MM:SS) when courts open. Before this time the actor logs in and opens the target date, and does not reload the court matrix. Example: 06:30:00. Leave empty to check as soon as the page is ready.

retry_for_seconds.title: Retry For Seconds
retry_for_seconds.description: After wait_until (or immediately, when wait_until is empty), keep reloading and checking for a free slot for this many seconds. Leave empty for a single check. 180 covers the rush after opening.

retry_interval_seconds.title: Retry Interval Seconds
retry_interval_seconds.description: Seconds between slot checks while retry_for_seconds is running. Use 2 or 3 so the club site is not hammered. Ignored when retry_for_seconds is empty. Defaults to 2 when polling.

timeout_seconds.title: Timeout Seconds
timeout_seconds.description: Overall actor timeout in seconds. Leave empty to keep 180 seconds, extended automatically so the wait until opening plus retry_for_seconds still fits (with two extra minutes for login and booking). The Apify task timeout must be longer than this.

placeholder_weekdays.title: Placeholder Weekdays
placeholder_weekdays.description: Weekdays for placeholder events on evenings that are not booked yet. Use monday, tuesday, wednesday, thursday, friday, saturday, or sunday. Defaults to tuesday and thursday.

placeholder_time.title: Placeholder Time
placeholder_time.description: Start time for placeholder events, HH:MM. The event stays 45 minutes.

remove_reservations.title: Remove Reservations
remove_reservations.description: Calendar sync only. Drop these entries from the stored history before the ICS files are written. Format: DD-MM-YYYY HH:MM, for example 19-10-2026 21:15. Empty by default.
